tex_content.html:
Corollary
[first Betti bound and flat-torus rigidity]

Source: petersen:page-0352 ↗ thm:pet-ch9-bochner-vanishing-1forms ↗ def:pet-ch9-hodge-cohomology 1. ch9:9.2.5For a compact $n$-manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature, \[ b_1(M)\le n. \] Equality holds precisely for flat tori.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch9-betti1-bound-flat-torus \sketch Hodge theory and subsection 2.2 identify $H^1(M)$ with a space of parallel forms. Evaluation at one point is injective, so $b_1\le n$. Equality supplies a global parallel frame and forces flatness. On the universal cover $\mathbb R^n$, deck transformations preserve that frame and are therefore translations; compactness and discreteness make the translation group a full lattice $\mathbb Z^n$. Conversely, a flat torus has $n$ independent parallel one-forms.

□

Thus subsection 2.2 obstructs nonnegative Ricci curvature whenever a closed $n$-manifold has first Betti number greater than $n$.
